gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-suwannaphum: Gaps spread wide at the curve ends give Stencilia a striking, structural look up top. Suwannaphum, a text serif, answers with dignified editorial height, while the heading simply makes its statement.
gen-dafont-stencilia-inter: Stencilia has a structural, striking build, with low stroke contrast and open gaps where its curves end. Inter, a plain sans, keeps one stroke width running through every letter, and that smooth, tube-like consistency is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-stentiga-fs-bespoke-sans: Stentiga spreads its letters out with a luxurious tracking, and its crossbars are as thick as its stems. Bespoke Sans brings sharp, refined curves with generous gaps before each stem, which is the quality that holds this pair together.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads classic and dignified, with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase. Stentiga makes its refined, luxurious statement through tails and terminals as thick as its stems, while Epunda Slab does the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-fauna-one: Literary and dignified, Fauna One sits low-contrast beneath a heading of constant pen pressure. Stentiga's spread-out tracking and wide openings pair with the body's tall middle band and shallow ascenders, and that shared generosity is what stands out.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Stentiga stays monoline and spaced out above it, so a long passage in the body would feel open, curved and unhurried.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-hanuman: Spaced-out, neon-tube smooth, luxurious: that is Stentiga, every stroke drawn with the same consistency. Hanuman, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals, adds traditional refinement.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-piazzolla: Stentiga's tracking is opened up wide, and each character has a marker-drawn plainness that feels luxurious. Piazzolla follows with an authoritative lowercase nearly matching its capitals, so a long passage would read with a pried-open e and a steady, confident pace.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-pridi: Spread-out and uniform, Stentiga keeps one stroke thickness everywhere and looks refined for it. Pridi, a classic serif, stands its small letters nearly capital-sized, so a long passage would read tall, generous and easy on the curves.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-scope-one: Refined from the first letter, Stentiga spreads out its tracking with zero stroke contrast. Scope One, a text serif, lets counters spill into surrounding space beside stubby ascenders and a big x-height, so a long passage would feel traditional and open.
